## Company context
Mom Boss Wellness is a coaching and community brand for high-achieving mothers and "sandwiched" caregivers — women carrying career, kids, and often aging parents at once. The brand delivers 1:1 and group coaching, retreats, and a supportive community around one core belief: **burnout isn't a personal failing — it's a sign the systems around her were never built for real responsibility.** The promise: *you are not broken; we help you build the support you actually need.*

## Sources
- GitHub: [ikigaicreative/MomBossWellness](https://github.com/ikigaicreative/MomBossWellness) — the brand's asset repo: logos/wordmarks/submarks in multiple colorways, the official color palette reference sheet, and the brand's licensed font files (Quicksand, Montserrat, Parisienne). This is the only source provided; there was no attached codebase, Figma file, or marketing copy/deck. **Explore that repo directly for the full-resolution source files and any updates** — colorway variants (BW, gold, purple, deep green social versions) live there beyond what's copied into this project.
- No product codebase, app, or website was provided, so this system does not include a literal UI recreation of an existing Mom Boss Wellness product. The component library and UI kit below are original interpretations built to the brand's visual language (color palette, type pairing, logo geometry) — treat them as a strong starting point, not a pixel-accurate port of a real screen.

## What's in this project
- `tokens.json` (compiled to `tokens.css`) + `components/bundle.css` — colors, type, spacing/radius/shadow, and `@font-face` declarations
- `assets/` + `fonts/` — logos, submarks, wordmarks, fonts, color palette reference
- `components/` — reusable UI primitives (buttons, forms, cards, badges, navigation, feedback)
- `ui_kits/site/` — a marketing/coaching-site recreation (home, program detail, coach bio) built from the primitives

## Content fundamentals
Because no marketing copy or deck was supplied, tone below is extrapolated directly from the company description and the brand's own name/logo language ("MOM BOSS", "wellness", "Sovereign," "Crown," "Radiant," "Rooted") — treat it as a considered starting point to validate against real copy when available.

- **Voice:** warm authority. Direct, plainspoken sentences; no corporate hedging. Coaching register — "you," not "moms everywhere" — always second person, addressing one woman.
- **Core reframe:** never blame the individual. Systemic language over self-help blame — "the systems around you," "redesign," "build," not "fix yourself" or "self-care hacks."
- **Casing:** sentence case for body copy and UI labels; the wordmark itself is set in full caps ("MOM BOSS") paired with a lowercase script "wellness" — that contrast (bold caps + soft script) is a usable pattern for pairing a strong claim with a gentler qualifier.
- **Sentence rhythm:** short declaratives, often two-part ("You are not broken; we help you build the support you actually need."). Avoid run-ons and jargon.
- **Vocabulary to favor:** rebuild, redesign, support, capacity, rooted, renewal, sovereign, radiant, community, real responsibility.
- **Vocabulary to avoid:** hustle-culture language (crush it, 10x, girlboss-as-punchline), clinical/diagnostic language, guilt-based framing ("you should," "just").
- **Emoji:** none seen in any brand asset; do not introduce emoji into UI copy or marketing surfaces.
- **Vibe:** grounded, premium, a little reverent — more "retreat" than "app." Confidence without hard-sell energy.

## Visual foundations

**Color.** Two coordinated palettes, both derived from the same five hue families (gold, evergreen, plum, rose, sage):
- *Elevated Calm* (muted/dusty versions) — Crown Gold, Rooted Evergreen, Sovereign Plum, Terra Rose, Sage Renewal. Use for coaching, retreats, premium print, anything intimate/high-trust.
- *Radiant Energy* (saturated versions) — Radiant Crown, Deep Grove, Power Plum, Ember Rose, Renewal Olive, plus Ivory Light and Rooted Ink as the neutral ends. Use for social, launches, CTAs, digital storytelling.
- Fixed meanings per the source palette sheet: **gold = leadership/light, evergreen = grounding/depth, purple = feminine authority, rose = warmth/humanity, sage = renewal/wellness.** Keep those associations when assigning color to new UI meaning (e.g. don't put a warning icon in plum).
- Neutrals/backgrounds lean warm (Ivory Light `#FFF8EF`, Sunlit Cream `#F6E6C8`) rather than cool gray — the palette has no true gray.

**Type.** Two families, one job each:
- *Quicksand* (rounded geometric sans) — headings, nav, buttons, the wordmark itself. Confident, friendly, a little soft at the corners; use Medium/SemiBold for most headings, Bold sparingly for hero moments.
- *Montserrat* (variable, incl. italic) — all body copy and long-form UI text. Clean and highly legible at small sizes; this is the workhorse.
- *Parisienne* (script) — accent only, never for a full sentence. In the wordmark it renders the word "wellness" beneath the bold caps "MOM BOSS." Use the same way elsewhere: one soft script word under a bold caps line, for a section eyebrow or signature moment — not for paragraphs or buttons.

**Backgrounds.** Full-bleed warm ivory/cream fields, not white. No photographic imagery, patterns, or textures were supplied in the source; treat photography as a gap to fill with real brand photos (warm-toned, natural light, real mothers — not stock-corporate) rather than illustrating our own. No gradients appear in any source asset — keep fills flat.

**Iconography / mark geometry.** The brandmark is a radiating sun/mandala form (see Iconography section) built from smooth, symmetric curves — no photographic or literal imagery. That "radiating warmth" motif (soft circular bursts, concentric rings) is the brand's one recurring illustrative device; the full logo also contains a seated/grounded figure silhouette inside a sun-ray ring plus a small wave motif at the base (calm, grounded, horizon-level).

**Animation.** No motion specs were supplied. Recommend gentle, slow easing (ease-out, 250–400ms) consistent with the calm/premium tone — no bounces, no snap. Avoid anything hustle-culture-fast.

**Hover / press states.** No interactive UI was supplied; the component library defines these from the palette's own logic: hover = shift to the adjacent Radiant-Energy tone (e.g. Rooted Evergreen → Deep Grove) or a subtle darken, never a hue change; press = slight scale-down (0.98) plus the hover color, no color inversion.

**Borders & shadows.** No card/shadow system in the source. The components use soft, low-contrast ambient shadows (see `--shadow-*` tokens) rather than hard borders, with a thin `--border-subtle` hairline as a fallback for flat contexts (tables, dividers). Corner radii lean generous and soft (12–28px) to match the brandmark's roundness — never sharp squares, never a colored left-border accent card.

**Transparency & blur.** Not present in source assets; not used.

**Imagery color vibe.** No photography supplied. Given the warm neutral palette and "Elevated Calm" language, real photography should be warm-toned and naturally lit, not cool/blue or heavily desaturated.

## Iconography
Mom Boss Wellness has its own icon set: **48 original line icons** drawn for the wellness realms of the five mom personas (Running on Empty, Rebuilding, on Pause, Reinventing, the Mom Who Builds). They sit on a 24px grid with a 2px round stroke and use `currentColor`, so one CSS color recolors them. Rooted Evergreen is the default; use Ivory on Evergreen or Deep Grove, and Rooted Ink on gold. There is no emoji or Unicode-glyph use anywhere.

Files: `assets/icons/svg/mbw-*.svg` (one per icon), `assets/icons/mbw-sprite.svg` (every icon as `<symbol id="mbw-name">`), and `assets/icons/icon-guide.json` (each persona's set of nine and the nine realms). The Iconography card shows them all, filters by persona, and copies an icon's SVG on click. This replaces the earlier Lucide sample set.

## Logo family (all in `assets/logos/`)
- **Full logomark** (`mombossw-logo-color.svg` / `-bw.svg`) — the complete mark: an outer ring, a radiating sun-burst of rays, a grounded/seated figure silhouette at center, and a small wave motif at the base. The most "complete" brand expression; use where a single hero mark is needed (favicon-scale down to the brandmark instead).
- **Brandmark** (`mbw-brandmark-color.svg` / `-bw.svg`) — the sun-burst/mandala symbol alone, no wordmark. Use as an app icon, social avatar, or small-scale mark.
- **Submark** (`mbw-submark-color.svg`) — brandmark + "MOM BOSS wellness" combined lockup, more detailed/decorative than the workmark lockup.
- **Workmark** (`mbw-workmark-color.svg` / `-bw.svg`) — wordmark only, no symbol: bold caps "MOM BOSS" over a script "wellness," each letterform drawn as a path (not live type) so it renders identically anywhere.
- **Social colorways** — deep green, gold, and purple variants of the full logo, brandmark, submark, and workmark (`*-social-deep-green.svg`, `*-social-gold.svg`, `*-social-purple.svg`), plus square social-cropped versions (`*-social.svg`) and an Instagram avatar crop (`mbw-avatar-ig.svg`), for use where the base color combination doesn't fit a given background.
- **Submark on dark** — `mbw-submark-social-on-dark.svg`: the submark on a transparent ground with ivory lettering, an ivory-edged orchid and the gold script, for dark grounds such as `color-rooted-evergreen` and `color-deep-grove`. Social and digital contexts only, not print; it disappears on light grounds.

Only base color + black-and-white + social colorway variants were copied into this project. Pull anything else directly from the GitHub repo if needed.

## Intentional additions
No component library, codebase, or Figma file defined a component inventory, so the standard set below was authored from scratch, sized to what a coaching/community/retreat brand typically needs (marketing site + light community surfaces): Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Badge/Tag, Card, Avatar, Tabs, Alert/Banner, Modal/Dialog, Nav bar, Footer. None of these should be read as "verified against a real product" — validate against the real site/app if one exists.

## Index

**Tokens** (`tokens.json`, compiled to `tokens.css`): colors, fonts (@font-face), type, spacing/radius/shadow; motion lives in `components/bundle.css`.

**Assets** (`assets/`): `logos/` (full logomark, brandmark, submark, workmark — color + BW), `brand/color-palette-reference.png` (source palette sheet). **Fonts** (`fonts/`): Quicksand ×5 weights, Montserrat variable + italic, Parisienne.

**Components** (`components/<Name>/README.md` + `<Name>.d.ts` + `preview.html`; sources in `components/src/<group>/<Name>.jsx`, compiled to `components/bundle.js`):
- `core/` — Button, Badge, Card, Avatar
- `forms/` — Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch
- `feedback/` — Alert, Modal
- `navigation/` — Tabs, NavBar, Footer

**UI kit** (`ui_kits/site/`) — marketing site recreation: Home, Programs, Coaches, Community screens, composed entirely from the components above. Open `ui_kits/site/index.html`.

**Guidelines** (cards at `components/LogoFamily`, `LogoSocial`, `LogoContrast` and `Iconography`; the Colors, Type and Spacing views show the tokens) — specimen cards for colors, type, spacing, radii, shadows, logos, and iconography. Every color swatch shows its hex code, and clicking it copies the code. Logo cards show a thumbnail of each file in `assets/logos/` over a background you can switch, and clicking one copies its file path.

## Logo color fix
An earlier export of the logo SVGs shipped with no embedded color (classes with no matching styles, rendering solid black). The source repo now exports with colors inlined directly on each shape (`style="fill:#..."`), and this project's `assets/logos/` copies reflect that fix.

## Font substitution note
All four brand font families (Quicksand, Montserrat incl. italic, Parisienne) were present in the source repo as actual `.ttf` files and are used as-is — **no substitution was necessary.**

## Using the tokens

- Set full-bleed pages on `surface-page`, cards on `surface-card`, recessed panels on `surface-sunken`; dark bands and the footer on `surface-inverse` with `text-inverse`.
- Set headings in `text-heading` with `--font-display`, body copy in the `body` style with `text-body`, metadata in `text-muted` (on `surface-page` or `surface-card` only), links in `text-link`.
- Primary actions use `brand-primary` with `text-inverse`; hover shifts to `brand-primary-hover`. Secondary actions use `brand-secondary`; launch CTAs use `brand-gold` with `color-rooted-ink` text — never white on gold.
- Errors use `state-error` only; every state color travels with a title word, never color alone.
- Corners: `radius-md` for inputs and alerts, `radius-lg` for cards, `radius-xl` for modals, `radius-pill` for buttons, badges, tabs and switches. Shadows: `shadow-soft` at rest, `shadow-card` for cards, `shadow-lifted` for modals; `border-subtle` only where a surface is flat.
- Space on the 4px scale (`space-1` … `space-32`); motion uses `--duration-*` and `--ease-*` from `components/bundle.css`.
- Pair a `caps-line` claim with one `script-accent` word in `brand-gold`, as the wordmark does.
